title: A renovation what-if on a database fork
about: What would make this house wheelchair-ready, and how many homes in the city would that help?

steps.say: A Los Angeles house. Today its doorways fail a wheelchair check.
The what-if edits a copy of the plan, re-measures it, then forks the facts database to count the city.

else.say: No database fork offline: the renovation on its own.

steps.say: The fork is a zero-copy copy of the Tiger service, deleted when the scenario ends.
